messages.content: GOAL BOS: TOP-10 finish. Build and SUBMIT an entry for threejs-fps-02 ($1000, finalize 2026-11-16T21:30Z): Three.js FPS game, main.ts, Node 22, deterministic seed REQUIRED, must run headless WebGL2 (swiftshader verified working on this box). Starter scaffold exists at /root/makefun/bots/threejs-fps-02 (commit 1a02051 from kit). Read requirements via the make.fun API and FOLLOW EXACTLY (deliverables, scoring). Build a polished, fun, stable FPS (solid gunplay, HUD, enemy AI waves, deterministic seed, no crashes) — winner-level quality, not minimum viable. Test headless render + gameplay loop for real before submitting. Then: push to public github.com/SufTTY/threejs-fps-02, verify commit reachable via GitHub API, submit with repo_url+commit_sha, verify post-submit status. Quota 3/3 left today. Report submission_id + what the game includes.

Read AGENT-BRIEF.md and fetched the full requirements JSON (deliverables: repo_url, commit_sha, bundle transcript, LICENSE, main.ts at repo root; grader runs `node /bot/main.ts` (node22) offline as user 65534 with empty /output, 120 s wall budget; run_deterministic check requires two runs to produce the same action log). Inspected the scaffold: main.ts copies game/ + screenshots/ to /output and writes dossier.json via vendor/makefun-threejs.ts buildDossier; game/ is static ES modules + import map with vendored three.js; serve.ts is a dev static server. Verified Node v22.22.2 on the box, found Playwright Chromium binaries at /root/.cache/ms-playwright (no driver installed), so decided to drive headless Chrome over raw CDP with Node 22's built-in WebSocket client using SwiftShader.

Rebuilt the game from the greybox scaffold into OVERRUN, a wave-survival tactical FPS. Wrote new game/src modules: rng.js (mulberry32 seeded stream), world.js (34x30 m arena, three cover rings, four spawn gates with emissive accent beacons, hemisphere+key+rim lighting), player.js (sprint/crouch/jump axis-separated collision, health, regen after 4s, hurt/revive), weapon.js (hitscan rifle: recoil kick, movement spread, mag/reserve reload, tracers, muzzle flash), enemies.js (three-state hunter drones: HUNT chase with cover sliding, COMBAT hold-range strafe with 0.45s visor telegraph then hitscan fire, STAGGER on heavy hits, crumple-and-sink death), waves.js (deterministic wave director: 3+wave units from seeded rng, field cap 11, intermission), hud.js (score/wave/health/ammo/kill feed/wave banner/hit marker/spread crosshair/vignette), audio.js (fully synthesized WebAudio SFX), main.js (fixed 60 Hz sim, seed param default 1337, ?shot=start|play|end deterministic capture frames, window.__game advance/freeze/spawnAhead test hooks). Rewrote game/index.html with the full HUD markup and import map to vendored three 0.187.0.

Built tools/capture.mjs: spawns serve.ts in-process, launches headless Chromium with --use-gl=angle --use-angle=swiftshader, drives it via CDP over the debug WebSocket (Target.createTarget/attachToTarget flatten sessions, Page/Runtime domains), captures the three ?shot frames, and runs a scripted gameplay smoke plus a two-run determinism probe. Debugging along the way: fixed a wrong server cwd, learned Target.attachToTarget returns the real sessionId, fixed waitReady polling the wrong session, and worked around headless rAF/timer throttling with a 16ms rAF shim and --disable-background-timer-throttling flags. Also hit resource leaks (stale serve/chrome processes causing EADDRINUSE and memory pressure) and cleaned them up.

Found and fixed four real gameplay bugs via the headless tests: (1) enemies spawned inside the side-gate wall colliders and froze — spawn now nudges into free space toward arena center; (2) the player-death flow never set the `dead` flag so the overlay restart broke — fixed; (3) recoil mutated pitch/yaw permanently so aim climbed away forever — replaced with a decaying recoil offset applied in syncCamera; (4) the shootable list was concatenated once at boot before any enemy existed, so bullets never hit drones — now built live from world.shootables.concat(enemies.hitMeshes) per shot. Moved firing/reload into the fixed step so scripted and live play behave identically. Verified via smoke: scripted gunfight scores 430 with headshots, enemies close and damage the player, death flow works.

Polish pass: brightened the six-value palette and light intensities (first screenshots rendered almost black), fixed a stuck damage vignette, gave enemy shells the light ink material so drones read as targets. Re-ran capture: all three shot frames ok:true with zero console errors, screenshots byte-identical across separate chromium runs, determinism probe true (freeze rAF stepping during scripted advance so wall-clock frames cannot consume rng), combat check true.

Verified the grader path: ran `MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=out node main.ts` twice — both runs wrote byte-identical out/dossier.json (md5 4a3a91754d10da75f40ebb977fd7e4c7), satisfying the run_deterministic check for the entrypoint; 19 files under out/. Wrote README.md (approach, run instructions, capture harness) and .gitignore for generated out/. Next: session.json hand-over, bundle via kit CLI, git commit, push to github.com/SufTTY/threejs-fps-02, submit with repo_url+commit_sha, verify status.
